title: OuroNex token usage batch
description: Request body for POST /api/v1/usage/. External applications aggregate token usage themselves and submit already-final counters; this schema never derives or counts tokens.

records.description: One batch is validated and applied atomically: either every record is written or none is.

record.description: Identity is user + source + day + model + sessionId. Re-submitting the same identity replaces every counter and the title; it never increments.

day.description: Local calendar date in ISO form, YYYY-MM-DD.

model.description: Model name exactly as the external application reports it.

sessionId.description: Session identifier chosen by the external application.

title.description: Optional human-readable session title. User content: never translated or rewritten.

calls.description: Number of calls in this record. Calls are not part of the token total.

source.description: Optional source label; defaults to external. Part of the idempotency identity.
